title: Object rotation + colour exchange
research_goal: Rotate each separate object clockwise and exchange two colours.

title: Size-based reordering
research_goal: Reorder differently sized colour bars without changing their colours.

title: Global frequency-based recolouring
research_goal: Identify the least frequent coloured object and recolour its cells.

title: Spatial mirror and translation
research_goal: Infer and combine mirror reflection with spatial displacement.

title: Largest-object extraction
research_goal: Identify an object by area and transform its appearance and location.
